title: Runs of the Framed Machine
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean-alphabet Turing machine, choose a clock tape among its work tapes, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. For every six-tape configuration $c$, contents and head positions for the $M$ tapes, and number of steps $t$, running the capture machine from the framed configuration for $t$ steps yields the frame of the timed-interpreter run from $c$ for $t$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: contents and head positions for the $M$ tapes
replaced:
For every $t$, running the assembled capture machine $t$ steps from a framed
configuration equals the frame of the $t$-step timed-interpreter run, with the
inactive frame unchanged.
